collection.title: Hyundai i30 Hatchback 2007 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Hyundai i30 Hatchback 2007 to 2010 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this i30 Hatchback, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
